under400.label: 400 分以下
under400.description: 基礎字彙、be/do/have、時間地點與簡單句型

questions.prompt: She has worked here ___ 2022.
questions.explanation: since + a starting point such as 2022.

questions.prompt: Please send the report ___ Friday.
questions.explanation: by expresses a deadline.

questions.prompt: The meeting ___ at 9 a.m. yesterday.
questions.explanation: A finished event in the past uses the past simple.

questions.prompt: If you have questions, please ___ me know.
questions.explanation: The fixed phrase is let me know.

questions.prompt: The documents ___ by the manager yesterday.
questions.explanation: Past passive = were + past participle.

questions.prompt: Our sales have ___ significantly this year.
questions.explanation: Present perfect uses have/has + past participle.

questions.prompt: Could you ___ the invoice again?
questions.explanation: Could you + base verb is a polite request.

questions.prompt: The new policy will take effect ___ Monday.
questions.explanation: Use on with a specific day.

questions.prompt: We need to discuss the issue before we ___ a decision.
questions.explanation: make a decision is the standard collocation.

questions.prompt: The company is looking for someone ___ can lead the project.
questions.explanation: who refers to a person in a relative clause.

questions.prompt: The office closes ___ 6 p.m.
questions.explanation: Use at with clock times.

questions.prompt: We are interested ___ your proposal.
questions.explanation: interested in is a fixed preposition pattern.

questions.prompt: I would appreciate it if you ___ reply soon.
questions.explanation: A formal request often uses would appreciate it if you could…

questions.prompt: The project was completed ___ time.
questions.explanation: on time means at the planned time.

questions.prompt: She is responsible ___ customer relations.
questions.explanation: responsible for is the standard phrase.

questions.prompt: The manager asked whether the shipment ___.
questions.explanation: Reported questions about a completed event use arrived.

questions.prompt: The product is ___ than the previous version.
questions.explanation: more + adjective for comparison.

questions.prompt: The report needs to ___ before noon.
questions.explanation: Need to be + past participle is passive.

questions.prompt: We had already left when the call ___.
questions.explanation: Past perfect + past simple shows an earlier past event.

questions.prompt: Please contact us if anything ___.
questions.explanation: Present simple is used in an if-clause for a real future condition.
